scenery @0:look#0.name: crowd
scenery @0:look#0.text:
In the Wings
The big top can be entered to the north and exited to the south. To the northeast, the grandstand begins its precipitous rise.
 
>

scenery @1:look#2.name: button
scenery @1:look#2.text:
Connection
This area of matted-down crabgrass lies between the vaulted big top entrance to the north and the enticements of the midway to the east, where a sagging banner hangs crookedly above a turnstile. There is a drinking fountain near the side wall of the tent. You can enter the night to the west and south.
 
The little general gets up on his tiptoes in front of the drinking fountain.
 
>

scenery @1:examine button#3.name: button
scenery @1:examine button#3.text:
You see nothing unusual about the button.
 
Attempting to do a pull-up, Comrade Thumb manages to sprawl himself onto the drinking fountain.
 
>

scenery @1:look#4.name: drinking fountain
scenery @1:look#4.text:
Connection
This area of matted-down crabgrass lies between the vaulted big top entrance to the north and the enticements of the midway to the east, where a sagging banner hangs crookedly above a turnstile. There is a drinking fountain near the side wall of the tent. You can enter the night to the west and south.
 
Straining his neck to reach the spout, the midget gropes for the button, loses his grip and plops to the ground before the drinking fountain.
 
>

scenery @1:examine drinking fountain#5.name: drinking fountain
scenery @1:examine drinking fountain#5.text:
It's your standard drinking fountain, with a button next to the spout.
 
The midget looks up at you sadly, then at the drinking fountain.
 
>

scenery @3:look#10.name: barred passage
scenery @3:look#10.text:
Beside the Big Top
You're standing next to the big top, which is gently flapping in the warm breeze.
 
A cheap plastic clown mask, having been carelessly dropped here, is lying face-up on the ground.
 
About waist-high, a barred passage for wild animals extends several yards out from the big top.
 
>

scenery @5:look#12.name: pair of sunglasses
scenery @5:look#12.text:
Back Yard
You're standing in front of the turnstile entrance to a fenced-in area, which is south. To the west stands a droopy tent, and the field continues north and east.
 
A tall and lanky clown in baggy pants trudges out of the tent and toward the turnstile. Comrade Thumb follows behind.
 
Adjacent to the turnstile to your south is a vertical cage.
 
The tall clown, whom you now recognize as Chuckles, barks a hello into the cage. You hear an electronic buzz from the turnstile and Chuckles passes through.
 
>

scenery @5:examine pair of sunglasses#13.name: pair of sunglasses
scenery @5:examine pair of sunglasses#13.text:
You see nothing extraordinary about the pair of sunglasses.
 
Comrade Thumb, in his squeaky and high-pitched voice, says "Hello Harry" toward the burned cage. You hear a buzzing sound from the turnstile as the midget reaches up to its lowest rung and passes through ...
 
>

scenery @6:look#24.name: figure of President Taft
scenery @6:look#24.text:
Inside Prop Tent
This dimly lighted tent houses a ragtag collection of outrageous props and wacky devices, including a midget automobile that's garaged in here.
 
Lying here in a heap is a gorilla suit.
 
President William Howard Taft is here.
 
>

scenery @6:examine figure of president t.name: figure of President Taft
scenery @6:examine figure of president t.text:
The imposing figure of President Taft stands quite still.
 
You can hear muffled voices coming from outside, getting louder and nearer. You feel the childish embarrassment of being trapped.
 
>

You hear one voice say, "Let's duck in here."
